item.title: Side Eye 1
item.description:
I feel like I need to look at the camera, break the fourth wall. Is this a performance? Maybe. It’ll make sense in some time. It is a performance perhaps. The masking is the performance. But the performance is not just for the world, my audience, but for me too, isn’t it? Sigh. I need to want to cut through it. The veil of … this performance.

Ok, going back now…

item.title: Blog 1
item.description:
I have been going down a rabbit hole researching (researching?) neurodivergence. I’ll tell you why.

I don’t think I have been researching. In the sense of what I would call researching. I’ve basically been watching a ton of videos on youtube. So, the information I have been consuming may be pop information, I don’t know.

Apparently, there’s a high likelihood that I am on the spectrum. Of neurodivergence. It’s a real catch-all, someone tells me. But then again, I don’t know if that someone was trying to invalidate how I am, how I feel. But whatever. You don’t know who I am. I don’t know who I am. So, :shrug:.
